thread:
Nora: quick follow-up from postmortem sync — proposed lightweight ownership-handback flow + IC-week pilot. want to avoid long tail actions.
Ben: curious what 'ownership-handback' means in practice. can you sketch steps?
Nora: yes — idea is an explicit handback token so an owner either accepts, declines with reason, or reassigns within SLA. reduces passive "no response" actions. draft below.
Rakesh: sounds promising. what's the SLA you want?
Nora: draft timeline:
```
T0 (incident): IC named, incident doc + channel created
T+24h: remediation items created; owners assigned; owner must respond with ACCEPT/REASSIGN/DECLINE (36h hard ack)
T+5BD: mitigation or rollback in place (short-term)
T+10BD: sprintlet end — either fix shipped, backlog ticket with assignee + due date, or escalate to eng lead
T+30d: verification or closeout note
Monthly: recurring-incident triage (severity x recurrence matrix)
```
Priya: 36h ack is slightly odd. prefer 48h or 24h. but I like the explicit ACCEPT/REASSIGN/DECLINE states.
Ben: Agree on states. can OpsBot add a comment on owner decision so audit trail is obvious?
IC-helper: I can: require `handback_state` field on the incident doc; when owner comments with ACCEPT/REASSIGN/DECLINE I'll stamp the timestamp and actor.
Rakesh: on IC rotation: propose IC-week volunteers drawn from SRE+Platform+App, but with a soft cap of 2 IC weeks per quarter per person. avoids burnout.
Nora: yes. IC handles coordination (assigning owners, running day-3 sync). oncall remains for immediate ops.
Priya: for action items, enforce a single-line machine-friendly format so boards ingest cleanly. e.g. `ACTION | owner:ben@example.com | task:replace-cassandra-watchdog | SLA:5BD | ticket:#4567`
Ben: good. small nit: include owner email and owner display name separated by `;` so PMs can see names.
Nora: updated sample: `ACTION | owner:Ben;ben@example.com | task:run-cc-check | SLA:5BD | ticket:#4567`
OpsBot: note: add tags `owner_of_record` and `handback_state` to enable automation. can also auto-create cards if `create_board:true`.
Rakesh: metrics to track: percent actions with accepted owner at 36/48h, percent mitigated by 5BD, sprintlet close rate at 10BD, repeat incident count (monthly).
Priya: pilot plan: run for 6 incidents or 6 weeks (whichever first) on P1/P2 only, measure above metrics vs baseline.
Ben: rollout items: short PR to /docs/incidents (timeline + handback format + IC-week rules), a tiny IC checklist, and a bot flag spec.
Nora: I'll open the PR and include a short FAQ for PMs and Eng leads. target: PR by next Tue. tagging @Rakesh for IC-week wording.
Rakesh: will review. I'll also prepare a short onboarding slide (1 slide) for IC volunteers.
Priya: Ops ask: make the owner handback machine-readable so the dashboard can show outstanding declines and reassigns.
IC-helper: ack, will expose a webhook for owner_state changes.
OpsBot: log: policy_proposal -> ownership_handback_flow + IC_week_pilot by Nora @2260001234
Nora: thanks all. small win if we can get owner ack rates up and fewer dangling actions. closing thread; PR link will follow.
